sous_titre: Milliards d'abonnements, fin 2025, mi 2026 et prévision 2031

Fin 2025.texte: In 2025 alone, 5G subscriptions are expected to top 2.9 billion by the end of the year

Mi 2026.texte: 5G subscription uptake continued in the second quarter of 2026, with 155 million new subscriptions bringing the total close to 3.3 billion

2031 (prévision).texte: Global 5G subscriptions are forecast to reach 6.4 billion in 2031 and comprise two-thirds of all mobile subscriptions
